import pandas as pd

# 读取训练集和测试集
train_path = r'D:\LLM-Driven_AI-Studio\MLAgent\data\benchmark/NL2Workflow/datasets/tabular/crime_category/train.csv'
test_path = r'D:\LLM-Driven_AI-Studio\MLAgent\data\benchmark/NL2Workflow/datasets/tabular/crime_category/test.csv'

train_data = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_data = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# 检查缺失值
print(train_data.isnull().sum())
print(test_data.isnull().sum())

# 假设缺失值较少，可以使用均值填充
train_data.fillna(train_data.mean(), inplace=True)
test_data.fillna(test_data.mean(), inplace=True)

# 编码分类变量
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
train_data['Category'] = label_encoder.fit_transform(train_data['Category'])

# 选择特征和目标变量
X_train = train_data.drop(columns=['Category', 'Descript', 'Resolution', 'Address', 'X', 'Y'])
y_train = train_data['Category']

X_test = test_data.drop(columns=['Descript', 'Resolution', 'Address', 'X', 'Y'])

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

# 初始化模型
model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)

# 训练模型
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# 进行预测
y_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# 保存预测结果
import numpy as np

np.savetxt('predictions.csv', y_pred_proba, delimiter=',')

from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# 计算logloss
y_test = label_encoder.transform(test_data['Category'])
logloss_value = log_loss(y_test, y_pred_proba)

print(f'Logloss on test set: {logloss_value}')

import pandas as pd

# 读取训练集和测试集
train_path = r'D:\LLM-Driven_AI-Studio\MLAgent\data\benchmark/NL2Workflow/datasets/tabular/crime_category/train.csv'
test_path = r'D:\LLM-Driven_AI-Studio\MLAgent\data\benchmark/NL2Workflow/datasets/tabular/crime_category/test.csv'

try:
    train_data = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_data = pd.read_csv(test_path)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"File not found: {train_path} or {test_path}")
    exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
    exit(1)

# 检查缺失值
print(train_data.isnull().sum())
print(test_data.isnull().sum())

# 假设缺失值较少，可以使用均值填充

test_data.fillna(test_data.mean(), inplace=True)

# 编码分类变量

# 选择特征和目标变量
X_train = train_data.drop(columns=['Category', 'Descript', 'Resolution', 'Address', 'X', 'Y'])
y_train = train_data['Category']

X_test = test_data.drop(columns=['Descript', 'Resolution', 'Address', 'X', 'Y'])

# 初始化模型

# 训练模型

# 进行预测

print(f'Logloss on test set: {logloss_value}')
